themes: Indonesia's energy transition hinges on PLN's capex cycle and feed-in tariff revisions, making policy clarity the dominant swing factor for local renewables valuations.
US solar demand is structurally supported by IRA subsidies and grid-scale backlog, insulating SEDG/ENPH from near-term rate volatility.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG

Ramadan and Lebaran seasonal demand is a durable, recurring catalyst for consumer staples, historically boosting volumes and margins for well-positioned local brands in Q1-Q2.
sectors.ai: Buy selective FMCG names with strong earnings momentum (BIKE, POLU, AGAR) despite the sector's -0.83% aggregate dip; the ID underperformance (-1.04%) vs US (-0.43%) is a short-term rotation, not a fundamental break. Favor mid-cap staples with volume growth and margin expansion, as household spending remains resilient ahead of Ramadan. Trim exposure to laggards lacking pricing power.
